 What's On BTS The City Arirang Singapore: Attractions happening around the island for Armys
 By Ashe Liao • 20 Nov 2026 
 Add as a preferred 
 source on Google 
 Copy link Share via Telegram Share via WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X (Twitter) Share on LinkedIn Share via Email Photography: BTS The BTS The City Arirang Singapore attractions and activations are set to take over the city in December! Here’s everything you need to know and where you need to be.
 It’s time to unleash the Armys as the excitement of the BTS World Tour Arirang builds ahead of the band’s four-night show at the National Stadium happening in December. This is one of the biggest city-wide activations we’ve seen for a concert in Singapore ! And it comes as no surprise. Now that the band has completed their mandatory military service, we’re set to welcome them back to the stage with a humongous bang. Ready to clock your steps in as you hit up every activity happening in Singapore? Let’s get started…

 BTS The City Arirang Singapore activations & attractions: National Gallery Singapore 
 1. BTS The City Arirang Gallery Rave 
 Photography: National Gallery Singapore A BTS-inspired activation isn’t complete without some kind of rave – our favourite type of event in the city nowadays! As the sun sets and daytime visitors stream out, the gallery opens its doors to a special after-hours crowd. Fans will be treated to BTS-inspired remix sets, immersive lighting, and projection visuals at the Singapore Courtyard. Your ticket also gets you after-hours access to the Pop after Pop: Art around Us exhibition, photobooths, and a complimentary Gallery Insider membership. Super fans can also treat yourselves to ticket-exclusive BTS The City Arirang water bottles, available in limited quantities.
 When: 18 to 19 December 2026; after-hours exhibition, 7pm to 8pm; rave starts at 8pm
 Price: $78 for rave tickets; $113 for the rave and a water bottle
 Where: BTS The City Arirang Gallery Rave , various locations around National Gallery Singapore, 1 St Andrew’s Road, Singapore 178957
 2. Pop After Pop: BTS The City Arirang Art Trail 
 Photography: National Gallery Singapore This unique art trail is being given a much-needed BTS treatment as the National Gallery Singapore weaves Pop Art and Arirang together in this tour. As you explore selected artwork through the building, each piece will be tied to a song from the Arirang album, complemented by access to the Gallery Photobooth. Tickets to the guided tour are sold out, but you can enjoy a self-guided tour and take your time to browse.
 When: Various dates between 12 and20 December 2026
 Price: Tickets start from $35
 Where: Pop After Pop BTS The City Arirang Art Trail , various locations around National Gallery Singapore, 1 St Andrew’s Road, Singapore 178957
 3. BTS The City Arirang-inspired menus 
 Photography: National Gallery Singapore It wouldn’t be a city-wide takeover without some delectable food and drinks! Select restaurants within National Gallery Singapore will be dishing out a curated menu of BTS The City Arirang-inspired dishes. Think signature cocktails and pastries, to big plates and special dining offers for fans.
 When: 11 to 31 December 2026
 Price: Varies with each location
 Where: BTS The City Arirang-inspired menus , available at Bakery Brera, Rempapa, Milli Sky Dining & Bar, and Milli Lounge
 4. BTS The City Arirang photo spots 
 Photography: National Gallery Singapore National Gallery Singapore is taking the BTS vibe very seriously because it’s gonna dress to impress for the occasion! As you tour the gallery, enjoy the special menus, and vibe to the Arirang album playing through the gallery tours, remember to snap some photos at various photo spots around the building. That way, you’ll show everyone who the true super fan is!
 When: 11 to 31 December 2026
 Price : Free
 Where: BTS The City Arirang photo spots , various locations around the National Gallery Singapore
 BTS The City Arirang Singapore activations & attractions: Orchard Central & Clarke Quay Central 
 5. BTS The City Holiday Escape: Themed photo spots 
 The Pool House at Orchard Central. Photography: Far East Malls A BTS-inspired pop-up may be a lot closer than you think! Throughout December, Orchard Central and Clarke Quay Central will host a series of themed photo zones, from an industrial-chic urban lounge to a pool-inspired backdrop. You can also drop a message on the holiday message wall and participate in a mini stamp rally at stations across both malls. There’s also an excuse to shop because you can redeem limited-edition collectibles with qualifying spends.
 When: 1 to 31 December 2026; daily, 11am to 9pm
 Price: Free
 Where: BTS The City Holiday Escape: Themed photo spots , multiple locations including Orchard Central and Clarke Quay Central
 BTS The City Arirang Singapore activations & attractions: Sentosa 
 6. BTS The City Arirang Rave & Drone Party 
 Photography: Sentosa If you didn’t get tickets to the BTS concert, fear not! You can still get the vibe at Sentosa’s rave and drone party happening over three days. This fan experience features live DJing by local K-pop DJ and Waterbomb Singapore performer DJ Raw, spinning tunes as the sun sets and bathes you in the golden hour glow. By night, a 1,500-strong drone show will take to the skies, set to BTS music in partnership with Visa.
 When: 18 to 20 December 2026, 5.30pm to 10.30pm
 Price : Tickets start from $30
 Where: BTS The City Arirang Rave & Drone Party , Palawan Beach, Sentosa
 Things To Do Things to do in Singapore this weekend: November 
 7. BTS The City Arirang fireworks & lightscape 
 Photography: Sentosa An explosive concert deserves some explosive pyrotechnics to light up the night. Themed fireworks will be set off on specific dates in December and on New Year’s Day, especially for the BTS festivities. Alongside the fireworks come the BTS The City Arirang lightscape, where projection mapping artworks will illuminate the Revenge of the Mummy facade with themed content.
 When: Fridays & Saturdays, 4 to 12 December 2026; daily, 16 to 25 December 2026; 1 to 2 January 2027; lightscape happens every night from 4 December 2026 to 3 January 2027, 7.30pm
 Price: Free to watch; tickets to Universal Studios Singapore required
 Where: BTS The City Arirang fireworks, Universal Studios Singapore, 8 Sentosa Gateway, Singapore 098269
 8. The BTS The City Arirang Run 
 Image: Sentosa Run clubs need to free up time to make their way to Sentosa for this fun-filled and relaxed 3km run. You’ll be running to the tune of iconic BTS music to energise you while taking in the afternoon view of Palawan Beach. Registered runners will get a race pack with a shirt, drawstring bag, Santa hat, and race bib, along with two island admission entries to Sentosa for the run. After that heart-pumping activity, continue clocking your steps at the post-run rave, happening exclusively for runners with the official wrist tag.
 When: 12 December 2026, 5pm; post-run rave starts 7.30pm
 Price : Tickets start from $77
 Where: The BTS The City Arirang Run , Palawan Green, Sentosa
 9. BTS The City Arirang Fan Village 
 Image: Sentosa Of course there has to be a fan village, because where else can you experience all kinds of BTS goodness all in one space? The dedicated fan village will be filled with interactive experiences and opportunities for fans to connect, play and immerse themselves. Grab tickets to complete a series of interactive missions, get your picture taken at the larger-than-life music box installation, and rotate between the play, taste, and beauty zones with F&B offerings, hair tinsel stations, and a chance to get themed gifts with purchase.
 When: 16 to 22 December 2026, 11am to 10pm
 Price: Tickets start from $10
 Where: BTS The City Arirang Fan Village, 8 Sentosa Gateway, Singapore 098269
 10. BTS The City Arirang Night Out 
 Photography: Universal Studios Singapore Here’s an extra excuse for anyone planning to visit Universal Studios Singapore in December – the park will be hosting a BTS Night Out for some after-dark fun. As the sun sets, ticket holders are invited to a special after-hours celebration. Not only will you get access to selected rides across the park and have special food and beverage offerings, you can also dance away with K-pop DJ sensation DJ Jagi.
 When: 21 December 2026, 8pm
 Price: Tickets to Universal Studios Singapore start from $115
 Where: BTS The Arirang Night Out , Universal Studios Singapore, 8 Sentosa Gateway, Singapore 098269
 11. BTS The City Arirang Giant Inflatable at Palawan Beach 
 Photography: Sentosa If you don’t know where to go for all the BTS-themed festivities, just keep your eyes on the water! A giant, nearly 10-metre-tall inflatable in the shape of pixel art inspired by BTS The City Arirang will be floating off the coast of Palawan Beach. Imagine the photo op with that inflatable in the background? Instagram-worthy, for sure.
 When: 4 to 31 December 2026
 Price: Free
 Where: BTS The City Arirang Giant Inflatable at Palawan Beach , Palawan Beach, Sentosa
 Gather ‘round, Army! It’s time to head to every BTS The City Arirang Singapore attraction in December.
 Frequently Asked Questions 
 What is BTS The City Arirang Singapore? 
 It's a month-long city-wide celebration organised in conjunction with the BTS Arirang World Tour! Several parts of Singapore are about to be transformed into BTS-themed destinations with plenty of fan experiences for everyone to soak in the vibe.
 Is Singapore the only SEA destination hosting this? 
 Yes, Singapore is the only city in Southeast Asia that will be hosting a BTS-themed city takeover.
 Will BTS members be at the attractions? 
 Attractions serve as fan experiences to celebrate both the band and the new album. It is unlikely the band will be attending any of the events in person, but you can keep an eye on official social media accounts for updates. 
 When is the concert? 
 BTS will be performing at the National Stadium on 17, 19, 20, and 22 December 2026.
 Do I need tickets to the concert to attend these events? 
 Nope! These events are hosted separately from the concert, so you don't need a concert ticket to access these activations.
